# Which projections each wiring path produces (plan II.0).
# Regenerate: go test ./internal/catalog/ -run Coverage -update-coverage

[derived (collectExtracts, shared by every path)]
  FieldValueKinds
  FireKeys
  KindScope
  LocAffixes
  LocFields
  LocListFields
  NestedShapes
  PrefixKinds
  Wrappers

[mod index (BuildIndex -> Harvest)]
  Defs
  Edges
  FieldValueKinds
  FireKeys
  Loc
  Order
  Refs
  Structures

[per-file save (ExtractFile -> FileExtract)]
  Cands
  Defs
  Edges
  FieldRHS
  MemberKind
  Refs
  StructBlocks
  StructCounts
  StructKind
  StructNested
  StructNestedKind
  Vocab

[derived, then dropped by the mod index]
  KindScope
  LocAffixes
  LocFields
  LocListFields
  NestedShapes
  PrefixKinds
  Wrappers
